units.source_text: 走不多久，有一间古雅的房子，可能是这村子里拥有山地的大户人家的。

en.t: Before long, there was an elegant old house, probably belonging to one of the wealthy families in the village that owned mountain land.

units.source_text: 略矮的墙壁，下半截镶木板，漆成黄红色；上半截是白墙，带葺瓦的小屋顶。

en.t: Its walls were rather low; the lower half was paneled with wood and painted a yellowish red, while the upper half was white plaster, with a small tiled roof attached.
